fingerprint.structure: 1 slide: title + a loose flat-lay collage of 11 to 13 cut-out items on white. An outfit stacked on the left (top over bottom) is the anchor, everything else (gadgets, a drink, an accessory, footwear, 2 to 3 app-screen widgets) floats around it in two loose columns
fingerprint.hook: identity starter pack: '<Identity> Essentials' as the only text, a bold title that names a tribe the viewer wants to belong to (builder). The pack itself is the hook: viewers check which items they own, and the in-joke widgets (an AI usage top-up, a revenue chart going up) make the identity aspirational and funny
fingerprint.camera_motion: other:essentials-flatlay. Designed card: product cut-outs (catalogue packshots on pure white, mixed angles, no shadows) plus flat app-UI snippets, all composited on one white canvas. Static image
fingerprint.pacing: single image, 2 words of overlay text; 13 objects, 3 of them UI snippets with small text
fingerprint.text_overlay: one title, bold grotesk sans (SF Pro Display Bold / Helvetica Neue Bold look), Title Case, black #111 on white, centred at the top, about 5.5% of frame height
fingerprint.audio: original sound by another account (humandisc), music bed, no voiceover
fingerprint.arc: recognition and aspiration: the viewer reads down the pack, ticks off what they own and lands on the joke items (MRR up 343%, buying more AI usage); payoff is identity, saves and shares to friends who 'are' this
fingerprint.measured: visual slide 1: brightness 73.1%, contrast 37.4%, saturation 2.9%, sharpness 572.8, noise 0.49, clutter 4.75%. Palette white #fdfdfd 59%, near-black #262626 21%, grey #5e6060 9%

layers.note: outfit top: black pullover hoodie, front view, laid flat, sleeves down. Biggest item, anchors the left column
outfit bottom: black shorts with a branded waistband, front view, directly under the top
dark grey laptop, half open from behind, logo visible
espresso in a glass cup with a handle
dark-mode modal from an AI tool: 'Need more usage?' with two top-up price tiles
an AI coding tool's app icon with its name under it
revenue widget: 'MRR' + green '+343.8%' pill, big euro figure, rising line chart
green glass bottle of sparkling mineral water

composition.balance: asymmetric: heavy dark outfit left, lighter scattered items right; items never overlap, gutters of 2 to 4%

frame.safe_zones: title sits at 9 to 14%, clear of TikTok's top bar; bottom item ends at 95% so the caption covers the keyboard and slides a little
frame.color_light: monochrome product palette (black, grey, white) with two colour accents only: the orange AI icon and the green bottle. Even studio packshot light, no shadows
frame.quality: mixed source sharpness, compression visible on UI snippets; reads as a quickly assembled collage
frame.origin_realism: real product photos and real app screenshots, collaged

text_blocks.font: SF Pro Display Bold (closest: Inter Bold)

image.item_mix: 2 clothing (top + bottom), 1 footwear, 3 tech, 1 wearable, 2 drinks, 3 app UI snippets, 1 app icon
image.outfit_slot: left column, top over bottom, together about 55% of the frame height; the only part that says who the person is
image.fixed_slot: everything else: the lifestyle of the identity, and the joke

other.what_it_is: a starter-pack / essentials board: cut-out items on white under a 2-word identity title
other.what_carries_the_message: the item selection, not the text; the title names the tribe and the items define it
other.layout_rule: outfit stacked on the left as the anchor, small items in two loose columns on the right, nothing overlaps
other.humour: two UI widgets are the punchline (buying more AI credits, revenue going up)
other.why_it_spreads: identity tagging and saves (2.5% save rate, 0.8% share rate)
other.text_rule: only the title is designed text; UI widgets carry small in-image text
other.colour_rule: monochrome items so the two colour accents pop
other.variants: the same board works for any identity by swapping the outfit and a few lifestyle items
other.risks: the source shows real brands (laptop logo, AI tool UI and icon, wearable, mineral water, a designer waistband): learn the slots, not the brands

product: none declared; real brands appear as lifestyle props (AI tool UI and icon, laptop, wearable, mineral water, designer shorts). No ad label
proof_device: app-screen widgets (usage top-up, MRR chart) as in-joke proof of the lifestyle
caption: hashtags only, no sentence: 1 tool tag, 1 identity tag, 1 money tag, 1 place tag
language: English, no voice beyond the 2-word title; insider in-joke tone
